newsitem.title: USA: Yellen sees no threat to U.S. expansion continuing.
newsitem.headline: Yellen sees no threat to U.S. expansion continuing.

text.p: White House economic adviser Janet Yellen on Friday said that despite the length of the U.S. economic expansion she saw no indication of troubling imbalances that could cause it to end.

In remarks before a U.S.-French business group, Yellen also said she did not think that the economy had stretched beyond its potential at this point but said policymakers needed to be cautious about economic overheating and the potential for inflation.
"I don't think we have crossed the line or stretched the economy past its potential," Yellen said.
